<!--
  Feedback record (AGENTS.md, handoff step 8). WRITTEN BY THE TEAM, never by the
  owner. The lead transcribes the owner's chat (or inline spec edits) into this
  file at specs/NNN-*/feedback/round-<k>.md, commits it before triage, then
  reads the triage back to the owner.

  Numbering: <k> is the round number, global and monotonic for the product
  (round-1, round-2, ... across all features and checkpoints; a repeated
  review of the same checkpoint is simply the next round). Item ids rNN are
  global and monotonic too (r01, r02, ... never reset). Both live in
  docs/STATUS.md "Counters".

  Delete this comment in the real file.
-->
# Feedback, round <k> (<checkpoint ID and GATE task, e.g. C1 / T011>)

Written by the team from the owner's chat of <date>. The owner's words are
quoted unchanged under each item; ids, timing, type and reference are the
team's reading, for triage. Anything the owner did not say is marked
**not stated**.

**Decision**: <approve | approve with follow-ups | changes requested | not stated>
**Publish choice**: <as recorded | keep it on my machine | open a pull request | publish automatically | not stated>
**Tried**: <which steps of the round report the owner mentioned trying, device/browser if said; else "not stated">

Timing: `before publish` | `next round` | `later` (backlog).
Type: bug (within the spec) | change (other than specified) | extension (new scope) | question | decision | praise.

| ID | Timing | Type | Reference | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| r<NN> | next round | change | FR-00x | [one line, the team's words] |

## r<NN> [short title]

> [Owner's words, verbatim, including typos and language]

[Team's reading: what it means in product terms, what would change, any
reproduction detail observed by the reviewer or the team. One short paragraph.]

## Not stated

- [Decision or question from the round report the owner did not answer; the
  lead asks it again in chat and appends the answer here with its date]
